subject.title: [Bug]: Inbound message not delivered to idle claude-stdio warm process; session sits 'done' until no-output watchdog (600s) respawns it (WhatsApp, macOS, 2026.6.1-beta.1)

question: Should this `claude-stdio` post-idle warm-process report remain a separate tracker, or should maintainers fold it into the broader WhatsApp/conversational lane recovery work now tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97538?
rationale: The shipped #95039 fix closed the older dormant-drain race, but this report has unique warm-process evidence while newer open reports cover overlapping owner-lock recovery policy; choosing the canonical tracker changes what proof and fix boundary maintainers expect.

options.title: Keep Separate Until Live Proof
options.body: Retain this issue for a focused current-main WhatsApp/macOS `claude-stdio` idle-warm reproduction before deciding whether the root cause is the broader owner-lock class.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Recovery Tracker
options.body: Close or link this into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97538 if maintainers decide the warm-process details are only supporting evidence for the same conversational lane owner-lock failure.

options.title: Close As Fixed By #95039
options.body: Treat the shipped dormant-drain fix as sufficient, accepting the risk that the exact post-idle warm-process path was not proven.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Until Live Proof
recommendation.body: Retain this issue for a focused current-main WhatsApp/macOS `claude-stdio` idle-warm reproduction before deciding whether the root cause is the broader owner-lock class.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle authored the merged #95039 queue handoff fix and is the strongest concrete owner-history signal for deciding whether that fix should close this report or leave a separate warm-session tracker.
